annotations.title: Dub a video into other languages

description: Full automatic dubbing of an uploaded video: transcribe once, translate, voice every target language with its own voice and render a dubbed video per language. Each language returns an audio_url (voice track aligned to the original timeline - upload it to YouTube Studio as a multi-language audio track) and a final_video_url. Takes several minutes: returns job_guids immediately; poll get_localization_status. Confirm the cost with estimate_video_localization for long videos.

original_audio_volume_percent.description: Keep the original sound (music/effects) under the new voice at this volume in the dubbed video. 0 = remove.

source_language.description: Spoken language of the video, e.g. vi.

targets.description: One entry per target language (the server allows 10 per job by default).

language.description: Target language code, e.g. en, es, ja.

voice.description: Voice token (v1:...) for that language from list_voices / favorites / custom voices.

name: localize_video
title: Dub a video into other languages
